claims.claim: Uniswap's CCA developer documentation describes the mechanism as generalizing the uniform-price auction into continuous time while 'eliminating timing games and encouraging early participation'.
The CCA whitepaper's Risks and Limitations section concedes that 'uniform-price formats are not strategy-proof in general and may still admit residual bid shading'.
The CCA whitepaper states that careful parameterization 'mitigates but does not eliminate' timing games, contradicting the docs page claim that timing games are eliminated.
The CCA whitepaper acknowledges that 'onchain execution inherits network frictions (e.g., MEV, L2/L1 sequencing latency)'.
The CCA whitepaper carries 10 references, of which the only classical auction-theory citation is Milgrom and Weber (1982); it cites no work on demand reduction in multi-unit uniform-price auctions.

Ausubel, Cramton, Pycia, Rostek and Weretka establish that differential bid shading in multi-unit auctions 'results generically in ex post inefficient allocations', covering the entire equilibrium set.
Uniswap's own technical documentation warns that 'the last block of the auction MUST sell a significant amount of tokens' because otherwise 'the final price will be easy to manipulate'.
The CCA technical documentation states that too-small tick spacing 'can result in a DoS attack where the auction cannot finish', and the permissionless factory does not enforce a safe tick spacing.
A core invariant of the CCA is that no bids can be exited before the auction has graduated, so committed capital is locked for the auction's duration.

The Spearbit/Cantina v2.0.0 review of the CCA contracts reported 10 issues with 0 Critical, 0 High, 2 Medium, 1 Low and 7 Informational, including a finding that a bidder could use force iteration to exclude other bidders' final-block bids; both Mediums were fixed.
DefiLlama's on-chain adapter reports $68,584,270 in cumulative realized Uniswap Auctions proceeds all-time, with $543,076 in the trailing 30 days and $0 in the trailing 24 hours.

DefiLlama attributes $59,240,697 of realized CCA proceeds to a single datapoint on 2025-12-06 flagged 'AZTEC Sale Completed', meaning roughly $9.3M of realized proceeds came from every other CCA combined.
Realized CCA proceeds by chain are Ethereum $67.72M, Arbitrum $465,451, Base $336,010 and Unichain $60,498, so Ethereum accounts for roughly 98.7% of the total.

Uniswap reports that roughly 17,000 participants verified identities and bid in the Aztec CCA, across 191 countries, with 96% of bidders contributing under $10,000 and a mean contribution of approximately $4,000.
Uniswap states the Aztec sale 'cleared at a price 60% above Aztec's floor price' and that 'no clear instances of sniping or automated price manipulation were detected based on onchain data'.
The Aztec auction offered 1,547,000,000 AZTEC, about 14.95% of a 10,350,000,000 genesis supply, and set a per-account maximum of 250 ETH.
The Aztec auction collected 19,476 ETH from 16,741 participants, clearing at approximately $0.047 per token.
As of 2026-08-26 AZTEC trades at $0.01468 with a market cap of $43.99M and a fully diluted valuation of $151.94M, against roughly $0.047 at auction clearing.
AZTEC's all-time high of $0.03990 on 2026-02-20 is below its approximately $0.047 auction clearing price, meaning the token has never traded at or above the price the auction discovered.
CryptoRank's Uniswap CCA launchpad page reports 9 total launches and $45.30M raised, a figure smaller than Aztec's single sale, indicating aggregator data on CCA totals is internally inconsistent.
Cap Labs' CAP is the clearest positive CCA outcome, trading at about $0.0712 with a fully diluted valuation near $712M as of 2026-08-26 against a reported clearing price near $0.011.
Of 533 public token sales held in 2025, only 63 (11.82%) were trading above their offering price at year end.
The CCA factory and auction contracts have no owner, pauser or proxy, and auction parameters are immutable after creation.

The protocol fee for CCAs is set by an external ProtocolFeeController owned by a single Ownable owner, expressed in pips against a 1,000,000 denominator, and read at fee-application time rather than at auction creation.
Uniswap Labs' Terms of Service state that 'Uniswap Labs is not the seller, underwriter, or issuer of any tokens distributed through a CCA'.
The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (H.R. 3633) was reported in the Senate on 2026-06-01 and has not been enacted.

The SEC's 'Regulation Crypto Assets' release (Nos. 33-11434; 34-106150, File S7-2026-27) was published in the Federal Register on 2026-08-21 as a proposed rule with comments due 2026-10-20, proposing exemptions of up to $5 million over four years and up to $75 million per 12-month period.
The CFTC settled with Uniswap Labs on 2024-09-04 for a $175,000 civil monetary penalty over leveraged retail commodity transactions offered through its interface.
Ethereum block building is concentrated, with Titan Builder at 47.6% and BuilderNet at 26.0% of blocks per Coin Metrics.
Basic Attention Token's fixed-price sale raised roughly $35 million in about 30 seconds, with 185 purchases succeeding and over 10,000 failing.

Gnosis publicly abandoned the Dutch auction format it used in 2017 in favour of batch auctions, writing in its own IDO contracts repository that 'the proposed batch auction system has a number of advantages over dutch auction'.
Hortacsu and McAdams find that switching from a discriminatory auction to a uniform-price or Vickrey auction would not significantly increase revenue, with bidder surplus gains bounded near 0.02%.
Kang and Puller find that in Korean treasury auctions the discriminatory format yielded statistically higher revenue and better allocative efficiency than the uniform-price format.
Uniswap v4 held approximately $952.5M in TVL against $23.96B of 30-day volume, so CCA's entire all-time realized proceeds are a small fraction of a single day of Uniswap swap volume.
A study of 655,770 pump.fun tokens found only 4,338 graduated, a rate of 0.63%.
The Uniswap CCA factory v2.1.0 is deployed at the same address 0x000000001F26a0044BaA66024e7b6599c61963F8 across Ethereum, Unichain, Base, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Sepolia.
The Aztec auction's graduation threshold was set to 0 ETH, meaning graduation was guaranteed regardless of demand.
Public crypto token sales raised approximately $58M in Q2 2026, the weakest quarter in five years and down sharply from the Q1 2025 peak.
